title: VPNs
desc: A VPN, or virtual private network, sends your internet traffic through an encrypted tunnel to a server, which can hide it from a local Wi-Fi network. It does not make you fully anonymous, and a poorly chosen VPN can see or mishandle your traffic. A VPN also will not fix a device that already has malware.
prompts: does a vpn make me anonymous
should i use a vpn on public wifi

title: Software updates
desc: Software updates fix bugs and close security holes, and they sometimes add features. Install updates from the official Settings app or app store, not from a random pop-up or text. Keep your phone plugged in or well charged, and back it up first if the update is a large system version.
prompts: why should i update my phone
is it safe to update ios
should i ignore update popups from texts
when should i install a system update

title: Public Wi-Fi safety
desc: Public Wi-Fi in cafes, airports and hotels is convenient but easier for others on the network to snoop if a site is not secure. Avoid logging into banking or entering passwords on unknown networks when you can use your phone's cellular data or a trusted VPN instead. Confirm you joined the official network, not a similarly named fake one.
prompts: should i bank on coffee shop wifi
how can i use public wifi more safely
use cellular data instead of public wifi

title: Cloud storage
desc: Cloud storage keeps files on a company's servers so you can open them from other devices, such as iCloud, Google Drive or OneDrive. Your files are only as safe as your account, so use a strong unique password and two-factor authentication. Check whether a file is stored only in the cloud, only on the device, or both.
prompts: are my files only on my phone or in the cloud
why do i need a password for cloud files

title: Email attachments
desc: Open attachments only when you expect the file and trust the sender. Check the real email address and the file type; unexpected .exe, .zip or unusual documents can carry malware. If a message looks odd, contact the person through a number or account you already have instead of opening the file.
prompts: is it safe to open an email attachment
what attachments should i not open
how can an attachment have malware
should i open a file from someone i don't know
check the sender before opening an attachment

title: Digital footprints
desc: A digital footprint is the trail of information you leave online, including posts, photos, comments, accounts and data collected about you. Even deleted posts can be saved or shared by others. Search your name occasionally, tighten privacy settings, and think twice before posting something you would not want a school or employer to see.
prompts: can deleted posts still be seen
what information do i leave online
why should i be careful what i post
can colleges see my social media
how to reduce my digital footprint

title: Social app privacy
desc: In a social app's privacy settings, choose who can see your posts, story and location, and who can message or tag you. Turn off location sharing when you do not need it, and review tagged photos. A public account can be seen by anyone, including people you do not know.
prompts: how do i make my social media private
who can see my instagram or tiktok
should i share my location on social apps
who can message or tag me

title: Blocking a number
desc: Blocking a number stops calls and texts from that number from ringing through on most phones. On iPhone, open the call or thread, tap the info button, and choose Block this Caller. Blocked messages may still be stored in a filtered list, and a person can try a different number, so also report harassment if it continues.
prompts: how do i block a phone number
how to block a caller on iphone
will a blocked number know i blocked them
can someone text me from a new number

title: Backing up a phone
desc: A backup is a copy of your apps, photos, settings and data that you can use if the phone is lost, broken or reset. On iPhone you can back up with iCloud or a computer. Back up before a major update or trade-in, and check that recent photos actually appear in the backup or photo library.
prompts: how do i back up my iphone
why should i back up my phone
back up before resetting a phone
will a backup save my photos
how to restore from a backup

title: App permissions
desc: App permissions are the kinds of access an app asks for, such as the camera, microphone, photos, location or contacts. Grant only what the app needs for a feature you actually use. You can change permissions later in Settings, and you can often choose While Using the App instead of Always for location.
prompts: why does an app want my location
how do i change app permissions
while using the app versus always
turn off an app's location access

title: Clearing a browser cache
desc: A browser cache stores pieces of websites so pages can load faster next time. Clearing the cache can fix a page that looks stuck or outdated, but you may need to log in again and pages may load more slowly at first. In Safari on iPhone, you can clear history and website data in Settings.
prompts: how do i clear my cache on iphone
why should i clear website data
a website looks stuck or outdated
clear safari history and website data
does clearing cache log me out

title: Pairing a Bluetooth device
desc: To pair headphones or a speaker, put the device in pairing mode, open Bluetooth in Settings, and tap the device's name. Stay close during setup, and type a PIN if asked, often 0000 or 1234 if a manual does not give another code. Forget the device in Settings if it will not reconnect, then pair it again.
prompts: how do i pair bluetooth headphones
how to connect a speaker to my phone
forget this device and pair again

title: If a phone gets wet
desc: If a phone gets wet, take it out of the water, power it off if it is on, and do not charge it or plug anything in. Dry the outside with a cloth and let it dry in a warm, dry place. Skip a bag of rice, which can leave dust and does not dry the inside well. If it was in dirty or salt water, or it will not turn on later, get professional help.
prompts: what do i do if my phone gets wet
should i put a wet phone in rice
can i charge a wet phone
explain if a phone gets wet
iphone dropped in the toilet or pool

title: Dark mode
desc: Dark mode uses a darker background that some people find easier on the eyes in low light and that can save a little battery on phones with OLED screens. It does not automatically make every app easier to read. You can schedule it in Settings or switch it in Control Center.
prompts: is dark mode better for your eyes
how do i turn on dark mode

title: Muting a group chat
desc: Muting a group chat keeps the conversation but stops most notifications, so your phone is not buzzing all day. On iPhone, open the thread, tap the group name or info button, and turn on Hide Alerts. You can still open the chat when you want to catch up.
prompts: how do i mute a group chat
stop notifications from a group text
how to silence a group message
turn off alerts for one conversation

title: Washing your hands
desc: Wash your hands with soap and water for about 20 seconds, including the backs, between the fingers and under the nails, then rinse and dry. Do this before eating, after using the bathroom, and after coughing or handling shared surfaces. Use hand sanitizer with at least 60 percent alcohol when soap and water are not available, but wash with soap if hands are visibly dirty.
prompts: how should i wash my hands
how long should i wash my hands
when should i wash my hands

title: Getting enough sleep
desc: Most teenagers need about 8 to 10 hours of sleep, and most adults need about 7 or more. A regular bedtime, a darker quieter room, and putting screens away before bed can help. If you often cannot sleep, snore loudly, or feel exhausted every day, talk with a parent, school nurse or doctor.
prompts: how much sleep do teenagers need
should i use my phone in bed
how many hours of sleep do i need
what if i can't sleep at night

title: Drinking enough water
desc: Your body needs water throughout the day, and thirst is a useful signal. A rough guide is pale yellow urine; very dark urine can mean you need more fluids. You usually need more water in heat or during exercise. If a doctor has given you fluid limits, follow that advice instead of general tips.
prompts: how much water should i drink
how do i know if i'm hydrated
does dark urine mean i need water
should i drink more water when it's hot
is there such a thing as too much water

title: Stretching
desc: Stretching can help you move more comfortably, especially after a short warm-up when muscles are less cold. Move into a stretch gently, breathe, and hold it without bouncing or pushing into sharp pain. If you have an injury, follow a coach or clinician's advice instead of forcing a stretch.
prompts: when is the best time to stretch
how long should I hold a stretch

title: Sunscreen
desc: Sunscreen helps protect skin from the sun's ultraviolet rays, which can cause sunburn and raise long-term skin cancer risk. Use a broad-spectrum sunscreen of at least SPF 30, apply it before you go out, and reapply after swimming, sweating or a couple of hours outdoors. Sunscreen is one part of sun safety, along with shade, clothing and sunglasses.
prompts: do i need sunscreen on cloudy days

title: Cleaning a small cut
desc: For a small cut, wash your hands, then rinse the wound with clean water and gently clean around it. Use light pressure with a clean cloth if it is bleeding, then add a bandage. Skip harsh cleaners in the wound unless a clinician tells you to use them. Get medical care if bleeding will not stop, the cut is deep or dirty, or you have not had needed tetanus shots.
prompts: how do i clean a small cut
what should i do if i get a cut
should i put hydrogen peroxide on a cut
how to stop a small cut from bleeding
cut is deep or won't stop bleeding

title: Treating a minor burn
desc: For a small heat burn, cool the area under cool running water for about 10 to 20 minutes. Do not use ice, butter or toothpaste. You can cover it loosely with a clean bandage after cooling. Get medical care for burns that are large, deep, blistered over a wide area, on the face, hands, feet or joints, or if you are not sure it is minor.
prompts: how do i treat a minor burn
should i put ice on a burn
can i put butter on a burn
when should a burn see a doctor
burned my hand on the stove

title: Choking first aid
desc: If someone is choking and cannot cough, speak or breathe, call emergency services right away and ask someone to get help. For a conscious adult or older child, trained first aid uses back blows and abdominal thrusts to try to clear the airway. This is not a substitute for a first-aid class, and the steps differ for infants and for someone who becomes unresponsive.
prompts: what should i do if someone is choking
how does the heimlich maneuver work
when do i call 911 for choking
first aid if food is stuck in the throat

title: When to call 911
desc: Call 911 in the United States for a medical, fire or safety emergency that needs help right away, such as trouble breathing, chest pain, a serious injury, a seizure that will not stop, a fire, or a crime in progress. Stay as calm as you can, give the location, and follow the dispatcher's instructions. If you are not sure it is an emergency, it is still reasonable to call.
prompts: should i call 911 for chest pain
how do i talk to a 911 dispatcher
is it okay to call 911 if i'm not sure

title: RICE for a sprain
desc: RICE stands for rest, ice, compression and elevation, a common first step for a mild sprain. Rest the joint, apply a cold pack wrapped in a cloth for short periods, use a wrap if you have been shown how, and keep the area raised. See a doctor or athletic trainer if you cannot bear weight, the joint looks deformed, or pain and swelling are severe or not improving.
prompts: what does rice mean for a sprain
how do i treat a sprained ankle
should i put ice on a sprain
when should a sprain see a doctor

title: Screen eye strain
desc: Long screen time can make eyes feel dry, tired or sore. Try the 20-20-20 idea: about every 20 minutes, look at something about 20 feet away for 20 seconds, blink often, and raise the brightness so you are not squinting. If headaches or vision changes keep happening, get your eyes checked.
prompts: why do my eyes hurt after screens
how can i reduce eye strain
should I blink more at a computer
tips for tired eyes from screens

title: Good posture
desc: Good posture means sitting or standing so your ears, shoulders and hips line up reasonably well, with your back supported and both feet on the floor when you sit. Keep screens at about eye level so you are not craning your neck down. Change positions and stand up sometimes; no single pose is meant to be held all day.
prompts: how should i sit at a desk
my neck hurts from looking at my phone

title: Warming up before exercise
desc: A warm-up raises your heart rate gently and moves the muscles you are about to use, such as a few minutes of brisk walking or light versions of the activity. It can make exercise feel easier and may lower injury risk compared with starting at full speed while cold. Save long, deep stretches for after the body is already warm, unless a coach has given you a different plan.
prompts: how should i warm up before exercise
why do i need a warmup
should i stretch before or after a warmup

title: Reading a nutrition label
desc: A Nutrition Facts label shows serving size first, then calories and nutrients in one serving. If you eat two servings, double the numbers. The percent daily value is a rough guide based on a typical 2,000-calorie diet, not a personal target for every person. Use the ingredients list if you need to avoid a specific allergen.
prompts: how do i read a nutrition label
what does percent daily value mean

title: Food allergies
desc: A food allergy is an immune system reaction that can be mild or life-threatening. Common allergens include peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, soy, wheat, fish and sesame, but any food can be a problem for someone. An intolerance is usually uncomfortable but is not the same as an allergy. Take a diagnosed allergy seriously, read labels, and follow a doctor's emergency plan, including epinephrine if it was prescribed.
prompts: what's the difference between an allergy and an intolerance
why do labels say may contain peanuts
is lactose intolerance a food allergy
what should I do if someone has an allergic reaction

title: Caffeine
desc: Caffeine is a stimulant in coffee, tea, many sodas and energy drinks. It can help you feel more alert, but too much can cause jitters, a fast heartbeat or trouble sleeping, especially later in the day. Energy drinks can be very high in caffeine. If caffeine makes you unwell or you have a heart condition, ask a doctor what is safe for you.
prompts: why can't i sleep after soda or coffee

title: Talking about stress
desc: Stress is your body's response to pressure, and it helps to talk with a parent, counselor, coach or another trusted adult instead of keeping it all in. Short-term tools include sleep, movement, taking a break, and slow breathing. If stress or sadness lasts, or you have thoughts of hurting yourself, tell an adult right away or call or text 988 in the United States for the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.
prompts: how can i deal with stress
who can i talk to about stress
what should i do if i feel really down

title: Brushing and flossing
desc: Brush your teeth twice a day with fluoride toothpaste and clean between your teeth once a day with floss or another interdental cleaner. Brush gently along the gumline rather than scrubbing hard. Regular dental checkups help catch problems early, and a dentist can show you a technique that fits your teeth.
prompts: how should i brush my teeth
why do i need to floss
how to brush along the gumline

title: Concussion warning signs
desc: A concussion is a brain injury from a blow or jolt to the head or body. Warning signs include headache, confusion, nausea, dizziness, balance problems, unusual sleepiness, or acting different from usual. Stop playing and see a medical professional. Returning to sports the same day is unsafe, even if you feel better quickly.
prompts: should i keep playing after I hit my head
when to see a doctor after hitting my head
why not return to the game after a concussion

title: Cooling down after exercise
desc: A cool-down is a few minutes of easier movement after a hard workout, such as a slow jog or walk, so your heart rate can come down gradually. It is a good time for gentle stretching while muscles are still warm. Stop and get help if you feel chest pain, faint, or severely short of breath.
prompts: how should i cool down after exercise
why do i need a cooldown

title: Making a budget
desc: A budget is a plan for your money. List your income, then list needed expenses such as food, transportation and bills, then savings, then wants. If spending is higher than income, cut wants first or look for more income. Checking it weekly helps you catch problems early.
prompts: how do i make a budget
how should i plan my money

title: Saving money
desc: Saving means setting money aside for later instead of spending all of it now. Paying yourself first, even a small amount from each paycheck or allowance, adds up. Keep savings in a separate account if you can, and pick a goal, such as an emergency fund or a purchase, so the money has a purpose.
prompts: how can i start saving money
how do i save from a paycheck
keep savings in a separate account
small amounts of savings add up

title: Checking and savings accounts
desc: A checking account is meant for everyday spending with a debit card or transfers. A savings account is meant to hold money you do not plan to spend right away and may pay a little interest. Some banks limit certain savings transfers, and both accounts can have fees, so read the account terms.
prompts: what's the difference between checking and savings
which account do i use for everyday spending
does a savings account pay interest

title: Interest
desc: Interest is the cost of borrowing money or the money you earn for keeping money in some accounts. If you borrow, you usually pay back the amount plus interest. If a savings account pays interest, the bank pays you a percentage. A higher rate helps you more when you save and costs you more when you borrow.
prompts: how does interest on a loan work
why does a savings account earn interest
do i pay interest on borrowed money
how interest costs or earns money

title: Debit versus credit cards
desc: A debit card spends money that is already in your checking account. A credit card borrows money you have to pay back, often with interest if you do not pay the full bill on time. A credit card can help build a credit history if used carefully, but carrying a balance can get expensive. Treat both as real money.
prompts: what's the difference between debit and credit cards
does a debit card use my bank money
does a credit card borrow money
credit card interest if i don't pay in full
can a credit card build credit

title: Credit scores
desc: A credit score is a number lenders use to estimate how reliably you have repaid borrowed money. Paying bills on time and keeping credit card balances low usually helps. You generally need a credit account in your name, such as a card or loan, before a score is created. Checking your own score does not hurt it.
prompts: does checking my credit score hurt it
why do lenders look at credit scores
pay bills on time for credit
what helps or hurts a credit score

title: Pay stubs
desc: A pay stub is the record that comes with a paycheck. It shows gross pay, then deductions such as taxes and benefits, and the net pay you actually receive. Check the hours, pay rate and deductions so you can catch mistakes. Keep stubs for your records, especially at tax time.
prompts: how do i read a paycheck stub
gross pay versus net pay on a stub
why are taxes taken out of my paycheck
hours and pay rate on a stub

title: Sales tax
desc: Sales tax is a tax added to many purchases, set by the state or local government. The register total can be higher than the shelf price because tax is added at checkout. Rates and which items are taxed vary by place, so the same product can cost a little more in one city than another.
prompts: why is the total higher than the price tag
do all states have the same sales tax
is tax included in the shelf price
why did my total go up at the register

title: Compound interest
desc: Compound interest is interest earned on both the original amount and the interest already added. In savings, that can help money grow faster over time. On a credit card or loan, it can make a balance grow if you pay only a little and interest keeps being added. Time and the interest rate both matter a lot.
prompts: compound interest on a credit card
why a balance can grow if i only pay a little

title: Needs versus wants
desc: Needs are things you must have or that would cause real harm to go without, such as food, housing, medicine and essential transportation. Wants make life nicer but can wait, such as upgrades, snacks or extra subscriptions. When money is tight, cover needs and a little savings first, then decide which wants are worth it.
prompts: what is the difference between needs and wants
is a new phone a need or a want
needs versus wants in a budget
cutting wants when money is tight

title: Emergency funds
desc: An emergency fund is money set aside for unexpected costs, such as a broken phone, a car repair or a lost shift, so you do not have to borrow right away. Start small if needed and keep it in a savings account you can reach without a penalty. Use it for true surprises, then build it back up.
prompts: how much should I save for emergencies
why do i need emergency savings
unexpected car repair or lost shift
where should I keep an emergency fund

title: Avoiding money scams
desc: A money scam tries to get you to send cash, gift cards, crypto or account codes, often by pretending to be a company, a crush, a prize or someone in trouble. Pause if someone rushes you or asks you to keep it secret. Do not send money or codes to someone you have not verified, and check a company's real number or website yourself.
prompts: how can i avoid money scams
someone asked me to buy gift cards
is this prize text a scam
someone pretending to be a company

title: Direct deposit
desc: Direct deposit sends your paycheck electronically into your bank account instead of giving you a paper check. Your employer needs your routing number and account number, which are on a check or in your banking app. Check the first deposit to confirm the amount and the account are correct, and tell your employer if you change banks.
prompts: how do i set up direct deposit
paycheck goes straight to my bank
direct deposit versus a paper check
where do i find my account number

title: Hourly pay versus salary
desc: Hourly pay is a set amount for each hour you work, and overtime rules may apply if you work extra hours. A salary is a fixed amount for a pay period, often quoted as a yearly figure, even if some weeks are longer than others. Compare offers by estimating total pay, benefits and expected hours, not only the headline number.
prompts: what's the difference between hourly and salary
what does a yearly salary mean
which is better hourly or salary

title: Writing a resume
desc: A resume is a short summary of your work, school, skills and activities for a job or program. Put your name and contact info at the top, then education, experience and skills, using short bullet points that start with strong verbs and show what you did. Keep it to one page if you are early in your career, and tailor it to the role.
prompts: how do i write a resume
what should i put on a resume
how long should a resume be
education and experience on a resume
how to describe a job on a resume
